### Fixed

- (gs) [Read semverFilter for a deployment's automatic upgrades](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2766) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On a deployment's page, the About card's `Auto-upgrade` takes the Flux tag filter into account and reads e.g. `Release candidates only` or `Dev builds only` instead of `Any`. `Edit` pre-fills the filter and whether pre-releases are included.
- (muster) [One name per MCP server auth mode](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2769) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — An MCP server's authentication mode has the same name everywhere, e.g. `Own account (OAuth sign-in)`: in the servers table, the new-server wizard and its review step, and in a new `Mode` row on the server's page.

### Development and CI/CD

- (deps) [Update dependency @sentry/react to v10.75.2](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2765) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
